descriptions.text: With a stay at The Cumberland, London, you'll be centrally located in London, steps from Frameless Immersive Art Experience and within a 5-minute walk of Hyde Park.  This hotel is 1.8 mi (2.8 km) from Buckingham Palace and 1.8 mi (3 km) from Piccadilly Circus.

Make yourself at home in one of the 1019 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks.
Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services.

Satisfy your appetite with British cuisine at SOUND Cafe, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee.
